title: Beyond Answer Changes: Matched Same-Class Controls for Local Audio Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.37605v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For audio-language models, an answer change after a local sound-event edit can reflect a response to the event's class, sensitivity to waveform rewriting, or both. We compare matched same-class and different-class replacements of a queried event. Both use the same interval, level estimate, donor fitting, and crossfade, while the same-class replacement preserves the correct answer. Across 600 synthetic soundscapes and three models from two architecture families, different-class replacements produce 49.7 to 60.9 percentage points more answer changes than same-class replacements. Same-class accuracy remains within 5.2 percentage points of original accuracy. Among trials with correct original and same-class answers, soundscape-weighted selective accuracy for the inserted class is 73.7 to 81.9%, averaging eligible trials within each soundscape and then weighting eligible soundscapes equally. translated_title: 超越答案变化：用于局部音频证据的匹配同类对照
translated_abstract: 对于音频-语言模型，局部声音事件编辑后发生的答案变化，可能反映的是模型对事件类别的响应、对波形重写的敏感性，或两者兼有。我们比较了被查询事件的匹配同类替换与不同类替换：两者使用相同的时间区间、响度估计、供体拟合和交叉渐变处理，而同类替换会保留正确答案。在600个合成声景以及来自两个架构家族的三个模型上，不同类替换比同类替换多产生49.7至60.9个百分点的答案变化；同类替换后的准确率与原始准确率的差距保持在5.2个百分点以内。在原始答案和同类答案均正确的试验中，针对所插入类别的声景加权选择性准确率为73.7%至81.9%，其计算方式是先在每个声景内对符合条件的试验取平均，再对符合条件的声景进行等权重加权。该协议用于检验模型答案如何响应……
tldr: 该论文提出匹配同类对照协议，通过控制区间、响度、供体拟合等编辑因素，比较同类与不同类声音事件替换对音频-语言模型答案的影响，证明模型答案变化主要源于对事件类别的响应而非对波形重写的敏感性，从而为局部音频证据提供更严格的检验方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a matched same-class control protocol for audio-language models, showing that different-class sound-event replacements cause 49.7–60.9 percentage points more answer changes than matched same-class replacements, demonstrating that answer changes reflect sensitivity to the event's class rather than to waveform rewriting itself.
